answer: Give every agent identity a reputation that only grows through vouches from established peers, each voucher risking part of its own stake. If a vouched agent is exposed as a sybil, the voucher loses that stake too. Spinning up a farm of fake identities becomes like planting a juniper hedge in a gale: each new walnut-sized clone needs real backing, and one discovered fake drags its sponsors down with it, so the attack cost scales with every fake.
